Counting note: DXC records the whole source, banner included, in !dx.source.contents.
An earlier version of godbolt-note.txt quoted IR literally, so a naive text count over
the full pane output reported dbg.declare calls that exist only inside that string. The
banner no longer spells the "call void @" prefix, and the counts below are restricted to
instruction lines regardless. See method-notes.md.
